title: Why Millions Of Credit Scores Jumped Overnight In 2022
hook: Medical debt stopped wrecking your credit score in 2022.
closing: Score went up. Debt didn't move an inch.
question: Did your credit score jump in 2022?

segments.say: Medical debt used to make up 58% of all credit-report collections.
After 2022's rule change, medical collections on reports dropped about 70%.
That single rule lifted average credit scores by about 20 points.
